responsibility: This Python maintenance tool scans GNU Modula-2 source files and rewrites or validates the standard header boilerplate at the top of each file. It recognizes comment styles for C/C++, Modula-2, shell, Python, BNF, and template inputs, parses the existing header to extract copyright year ranges, contribution text, summary line, and license variant, and then regenerates normalized GPL/LGPL/ISO copyright blocks when requested. It also provides recursive extension-based traversal and command-line controls for forcing required metadata, selecting GPLv3 or runtime-exception forms, updating dates, and emitting diagnostics when headers are malformed or incomplete.
